raw_definition: MASt3R reciprocal descriptor-NN matches after the locked 3-pixel crop border, linearly triangulated with fixed COLMAP K[R|t], finite homogeneous DLT, and positive depth in both cameras; no reprojection-error ceiling
pair_selection_rule: all locked P-J/P-L visible-view combinations; sort by minimum frozen address support descending, then sum descending, stems ascending; cap 10
summary_pair_rule: pool footprint-inside points from cross-acquisition-minute-block pairs with fixed-COLMAP camera-centre baseline greater than 0.06 m; preserve every selected pair in run detail

coverage.denominator: EPSG:25832 grid cells whose closed square intersects the supplied footprint
coverage.numerator: eligible denominator cells containing at least one selected footprint-inside DLT point

good_operating_point.selection_rule: among dial rows meeting both bounds, maximize coverage; ties use smaller median absolute delta-z, then stricter dial order 2px,4px,8px,raw; if none, label INSUFFICIENT_INSIDE_POINTS

execution_lock.new_mast3r_inference_scope: only the selected view pairs for targets 4907199 and 8568392 in this dense-dial run
execution_lock.footprint_role: post-DLT spatial score mask and coverage denominator only

chart_contract.question: How does the locked reprojection dial change pooled footprint-inside count, 0.5 m intersect-cell coverage, and median absolute LoD2 height error?
chart_contract.palette: single blue root plus neutral references; marker and line style distinguish buildings
